hero_sub: Rähle hand-builds tribute cars in Argentina, piece by piece. Our first car honors Porsche's No. 55 — the 550 Spyder that carried Hans Herrmann to a class win at the 1954 Carrera Panamericana.
break1_text: Not a display piece. A car built for the next generation of racers to actually drive.
break2_text: A small team, building one car at a time — every rivet, panel, and weld done by hand.
break3_text: Every car starts as separate parts — body, chassis, seats, wheels — and comes together only once it's yours.
history_headline:
This isn't
a toy.
It's a
tribute.
history_p1: In 1954, a 28-year-old Hans Herrmann drove a 110-horsepower Porsche 550 Spyder across 3,000 kilometers of Mexico in the Carrera Panamericana — one of the most dangerous road races ever run. Car No. 55 won its class and finished third overall, outrunning cars twice its size.
history_p2: Rähle's first car is a hand-built tribute to that Spyder — built piece by piece in Argentina, on a tubular steel-and-aluminum chassis, true to the proportions and spirit of the original.
eng1_desc: The pedals slide forward and back on a track, so the same car fits a smaller driver today and a taller one next year — no refit required.
eng2_desc: A built-in limiter caps top speed while a new driver is learning. Turn it up as they get more confident behind the wheel.
eng3_desc: A hand-welded steel-and-aluminum spaceframe — the same construction method used on real vintage race cars, not a toy shell over a go-kart frame.
eng4_desc: Coilover shocks at each corner, tuned to soak up a real dirt track instead of bouncing over it.
eng5_desc: Hydraulic disc brakes, not a friction pedal — the car stops the way it should, every time.
eng6_desc: A true steering rack connects the wheel to the front wheels directly, with the road feel of the original.
eng_image1_caption: The engine bay, with the tubular chassis and 110cc engine exposed.
eng_image2_caption: The bare chassis — tubular steel and aluminum, before the body goes on.
config_body_desc: Fiberglass keeps it light and true to period race cars. Aluminum is hand-formed over the original's proportions, panel by panel.
config_seating_desc: Single seat, like the works cars that raced the Panamericana. Two seat for sharing the drive.
config_engine_desc: Choose how it drives: an easy 3-speed for cruising, a race-spec go-kart engine for the track, or fully electric.
config_color_desc: Five liveries pulled from motorsport history.
config_render_caption_html: Shown: GT Silver — your color built to order
quote_sub: Every car is custom-built to order. Submit your configuration and we'll follow up with pricing and lead time.
